description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **token** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The description of the firewall template.
The ID of the firewall template.
The firewall rule in the template.
The ID of the firewall rule.

description.zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

> 如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1。
description.en:
The port range. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 1024 to 1055.

> If you set RuleProtocol to ICMP, you must set Port to -1/-1.
The remarks of the firewall template rule.

description.zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

- TCP：TCP协议。
- UDP：UDP协议。
- TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
- ICMP：ICMP协议。
description.en:
The transport layer protocol that the rule supports. Valid values:

- TCP

- UDP

- TCP+UDP

- ICMP

description.zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The source address to which you want to grant access permissions. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.
The name of the firewall template.

description.zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 修改防火墙模板不会影响已应用当前模板的实例规则。
descriptions.en: Modifying a firewall template does not affect the firewall rules that have been applied to simple application servers.
